Demo catalog. Specs relayed from web search summaries on 2026-09-08, then the product page was read by Codex on 2026-09-09 at 15:40 Pacific. The page describes a reimagined Original with a Pro Chiller Gen2 included, and nothing here establishes that the older relayed summary described the same model. What can be shown is that seven figures agree exactly: 66-5/8 by 31-1/2 by 26 in, 144 lb empty, 105 gallons, an 80 in maximum user height, 37°F, a chiller included and a 1-year warranty. Those stand whichever model the summary meant, and they are cited to the page with that caveat. The price does not agree, and it is left as relayed rather than converted: see the offer note. App temperature control and insulation are read from this page. Stock, images and any health claim remain unverified.
